SUMMARY: The PineconeFactory builds a procedural pinecone by subclassing MonocotGrowthFactory: a central stem curve has flat scale "leaves" instanced along it in a spiral (via accumulated z-rotation and increasing y-tilt), then twisted/bent and shaded reddish-brown. growth.py provides the generic monocot growth engine (stem, leaf instancing along a curve, material shader, post-deformation), while pinecone.py overrides the leaf geometry, packing spiral, scale-size profile, and colors to produce a cone shape. NOTE: to satisfy the requested "cubic pinecone" (scales on 6 cube faces in square grids), the spiral instancing in growth.py's make_geo_flower would need to be replaced with cube-face grid placement — currently NOT implemented.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/monocot/pinecone.py
  PineconeFactory.__init__: sets pinecone-specific packing, size, color
    knobs: self.angle (2*pi/(randint(4,8)+0.5), random) -> spiral divergence angle between successive scales; smaller denominator = looser spiral
    knobs: self.max_y_angle (uniform(0.7,0.8)*pi/2, random) -> how far scales tilt outward toward the top = cone openness
    knobs: self.leaf_prob (uniform(0.9,0.95), random) -> fraction of stem points that get a scale (higher=denser)
    knobs: self.count (int(log_uniform(64,96)), random) -> number of scale placement points along stem
    knobs: self.stem_offset (uniform(0.2,0.4), random) -> stem length / overall pinecone height
    knobs: self.perturb (0, fixed) -> random jitter of rotation/scale per scale (0 = perfectly regular)
    knobs: self.scale_curve ([(0,0.5),(0.5,uniform(0.6,1.0)),(1,uniform(0.1,0.2))], partly random) -> scale size along stem: small base, mid bulge, tiny tip = cone silhouette
    knobs: self.bright_color / self.dark_color (hsv2rgba(hue uniform(0.02,0.06), sat uniform(0.8,1.0), val 0.01/0.005), random) -> reddish-brown scale colors; hue near red-orange, very low value
  PineconeFactory.build_leaf: builds one flat scale plate
    knobs: new_circle(vertices=128) -> base scale resolution
    knobs: angles (np.array([-1,-.8,-.5,0,.5,.8,1])*self.angle/2, fixed pattern) -> angular cross-section profile of scale width
    knobs: scale = uniform(0.9,0.95) & scales list -> scale plate width taper across its span
    knobs: displacement=[0,0,0,-uniform(0.2,0.3),0,0,0] (random) -> center concavity/curl of scale
    knobs: shape_by_xs xs=[0,1,2], displacement=[0,0,0.5] -> longitudinal lift/tip flare of scale
    knobs: obj.scale=[0.1]*3 (fixed) -> overall scale plate size relative to stem
    knobs: obj.rotation_euler[1]-=uniform(pi/18,pi/12) (random) -> scale pitch against stem
    knobs: texture.noise_scale=log_uniform(0.002,0.005) & DISPLACE strength=0.001 -> fine surface bumpiness of scale
  PineconeFactory.shader_monocot: overrides base shader
    knobs: specular=uniform(0.2,0.4) (random) -> glossiness
    knobs: color ramp stops [0,0.3,0.7,1.0] over musgrave(10) -> bright/dark mottling pattern
    knobs: roughness float curve [(0,0.5),(1,0.8)] -> matte-to-rough variation

FILE: assets/objects/monocot/growth.py
  MonocotGrowthFactory.__init__: base growth defaults (overridden by pinecone for many)
    knobs: self.count(128), self.perturb(0.05), self.angle(pi/6), self.min_y_angle(0.0), self.max_y_angle(pi/2) -> leaf placement spiral/tilt
    knobs: self.leaf_prob(uniform(0.8,0.9)), self.leaf_range((0,1)) -> which stem points get leaves
    knobs: self.stem_offset(0.2), self.radius(0.01) -> stem length & thickness
    knobs: self.scale_curve([(0,1),(1,1)]) -> leaf size along stem
    knobs: self.bend_angle(pi/4), self.twist_angle(pi/6), self.z_drag(0.0), self.z_scale(uniform(1.0,1.2)) -> post deform of whole plant
    knobs: self.align_factor(0), self.align_direction((1,0,0)) -> optional leaf alignment to a vector
    knobs: base/bright/dark color (green-ish default, overridden by pinecone)
  MonocotGrowthFactory.make_geo_flower: THE SPIRAL PLACEMENT ENGINE — instances leaves on a resampled stem line with accumulated z_rotation (spiral) and curve-driven y_rotation/scale. **This is where cube-face grid placement must replace the CurveLine/AccumulateField spiral to satisfy the request.**
    knobs: line End=(0,0,stem_offset); ResampleCurve count=self.count; y_rotation curve endpoints (-min_y_angle..-max_y_angle); z_rotation via AccumulateField(uniform(angle*0.95,angle*1.05))
  MonocotGrowthFactory.decorate_monocot: final scale/rotate/twist/bend + material
    knobs: twist angle uniform(-twist_angle,twist_angle); bend uniform(0,bend_angle); obj.scale=(uniform(0.8,1.2),uniform(0.8,1.2),z_scale); random z-rotation
  MonocotGrowthFactory.build_stem: subdivided cylinder stem
    knobs: SUBSURF levels=9; geo_radius(radius,16); DISPLACE noise_scale=0.1 strength=0.01
  MonocotGrowthFactory.decorate_leaf / build_instance / make_collection: leaf bending/noise helpers (not called by pinecone's simple build_leaf path except via make_collection of 10 variants)
    knobs: make_asset_collection count=10 (leaf variants)
  MonocotGrowthFactory.shader_monocot: base green shader (overridden by pinecone)

FILE: assets/objects/monocot/__init__.py
  module exports; registers PineconeFactory among monocot factories (no tunables)

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/utils/decorate.py -> displace_vertices, geo_extension mesh deformers
  assets/utils/draw.py -> shape_by_angles / shape_by_xs scale-shaping used to sculpt each scale
  assets/utils/mesh.py -> mesh construction helpers
  assets/utils/misc.py -> assign_material helper
  assets/utils/nodegroup.py -> geo_radius nodegroup for stem thickness
  assets/utils/object.py -> new_circle, data2mesh, mesh2obj, origin2leftmost
  core/nodes/node_info.py -> Nodes enum (geometry/shader node ids)
  core/nodes/node_utils.py -> build_color_ramp
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py -> NodeWrangler node-graph builder API
  core/nodes/nodegroups/transfer_attributes.py -> attribute transfer on remesh
  core/placement/detail.py -> remesh_with_attrs, adapt_mesh_resolution (face_size control)
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base, make_asset_collection
  core/surface.py -> add_geomod, shaderfunc_to_material, eval_argument
  core/tagging.py, core/tags.py -> tag_object semantic tagging
  core/util/blender.py -> butil modify_mesh/ViewportMode/apply_transform ops
  core/util/color.py -> hsv2rgba color conversion
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed deterministic seeding
  core/util/random.py -> log_uniform sampling
